estimateBasis: Installed file_packager.py writes each source file to the archive sequentially rather than loading the entire source tree.
Installed lz4-compress.mjs reads the runtime archive and constructs a Uint8Array copy.
Installed mini-lz4.js retains per-chunk compression buffers, allocates the joined compressed output, and lz4-compress.mjs constructs a final Buffer for writing.

Five archive-sized transient buffers are about 0.82 GiB for this dataset; 1.5 GiB allows interpreter, Python, wrapper, catalog, metadata and garbage-collection overhead. This is an estimate, not an observed upper bound.
